description: Volume 3 of FEMA P-58, Seismic Performance Assessment of Buildings, now in its third edition, bundles the electronic materials behind the methodology, including the fragility and consequence data for structural and nonstructural building components. The Fragility Database is an Excel workbook for reviewing and maintaining all provided fragility and consequence data outside PACT and, since the second edition, includes environmental impact consequences; the Fragility Specification PDF shows each component on one page with photographs of damage states where available. A PACT Input Matrix, a Consequence Estimation Summary and a Normative Quantity Estimation Tool, which estimates nonstructural component quantities by occupancy and floor area, complete the set. Coverage: U.S. building components and occupancies. Access: free downloads from the ATC-hosted FEMA P-58 site. Licence: FEMA publication terms, not stated on the pages read. Caveats: consequence values reflect U.S. repair costs and practice, and the ATC-138 project is extending the method to functional recovery. Simulation uses: component-level damage and consequence inputs for building-specific seismic loss, repair time, casualty and environmental impact estimates. Related records: the PACT calculation tool, pelicun, which reuses these data, and the SimCenter R2D tool.
